instruction: Install SFTP-only chroot server (already configured via SSH)
output:
groupadd sftp-only && useradd -m -s /sbin/nologin -G sftp-only sftpuser && echo -e '
Match Group sftp-only
  ChrootDirectory %h
  ForceCommand internal-sftp
  X11Forwarding no
  AllowTcpForwarding no' >> /etc/ssh/sshd_config && systemctl restart sshd

instruction: Configure VNC to start on boot as a service
output:
cat > /etc/systemd/system/vncserver@.service << 'EOF'
[Unit]
Description=VNC Server
[Service]
ExecStart=/usr/bin/vncserver %i -geometry 1280x720
ExecStop=/usr/bin/vncserver -kill %i
[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
EOF && systemctl enable --now vncserver@1
